items.title: NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom Announce Collaboration to Advance Sovereign AI Infrastructure With NVIDIA NVLink Fusion
items.summary: Korean-Designed AI Processors and Models to Build on NVIDIA NVLink Fusion and MGX Infrastructure for Rack-Scale Inference NVIDIA NVLink Fusion NVIDIA, Rebellions and SK Telecom today announced a collaboration to advance Korea’s sovereign AI infrastructure — using NVIDIA NVLink Fusion to bring together NVIDIA’s open infrastructure platform, Rebellions’ Korean-designed AI processors and SK Telecom’s AI data center, model and service capabilities. items.title: Trump calls Nvidia’s Huang ‘honorable,’ says yet to discuss China allegations
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday evening praised Nvidia’s Jensen Huang for his contributions to the country, and said he had not spoken to the CEO regarding allegations of a relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

items.title: Micron Technology And 2 High Growth Stocks To Watch
items.summary: Rising concern about US government debt and higher Treasury yields has pushed many investors to rethink where they want growth exposure. Strong balance sheets and solid earnings momentum can feel more attractive when borrowing costs are in focus and market swings are sharper. This article highlights three financially healthy companies identified by analysts as having the potential for rapid profit growth over the next few years, drawn from a screener built around that idea.
